facts: Floating ability: Apples can float in water because 25% of their volume is made up of air.
Growth timeline: Standard-size apple trees take 8 to 10 years to bear fruit from seeds, while dwarf trees produce fruit in 3 to 5 years.
Ripening speed: Apples ripen six to ten times faster at room temperature than when stored in a refrigerator.
Cider math: It takes roughly 36 medium apples to make one gallon of apple cider.
